title: Acceptance Limits for Pass and Trip Protection Cover
content:
A plan under Pass and Trip Protection is written over one holding the household already carries, and each of
the six plans is written only within the limits set out here: the product lines of the collective whose
holdings that plan may be written over, the smallest and largest value of a holding it may be written over,
the number of calendar days after the covered holding was opened within which the plan may still be taken,
and the youngest and oldest age in whole years a named insured may be.

| Plan | Product lines covered | Smallest covered value (USD) | Largest covered value (USD) | Purchase window (calendar days) | Youngest insured (years) | Oldest insured (years) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Season Pass Protection Basic | Season passes | 379.00 | 1149.00 | 7 | 5 | 79 |
| Season Pass Protection Plus | Season passes | 559.00 | 2649.00 | 14 | 5 | 79 |
| Season Pass Protection Premier | Season passes | 789.00 | 2649.00 | 21 | 5 | 84 |
| Collective Trip Protection Standard | Lodging, snowsports school | 250.00 | 9000.00 | 14 | 18 | 79 |
| Collective Trip Protection Elite | Lodging, snowsports school, equipment rental | 500.00 | 18000.00 | 21 | 18 | 84 |
| Collective Total Protection Concierge | Season passes, lodging, snowsports school, equipment rental, lift tickets | 1500.00 | 60000.00 | 45 | 18 | 89 |

**Reading the value limits.** The two ends of each row are inclusive: a holding valued at exactly 379.00 USD
falls inside Season Pass Protection Basic, and so does one valued at exactly 1149.00 USD. A pass valued at
1200.00 USD falls outside Basic altogether and inside Season Pass Protection Plus, whose band runs from
559.00 USD to 2649.00 USD.

**Reading the age limits.** The three pass plans are written over an insured as young as 5 years, the three
plans written over trip holdings only over an insured of 18 years or more. At the other end the range stops
at 79 years on Season Pass Protection Basic, Season Pass Protection Plus and Collective Trip Protection
Standard, at 84 years on Season Pass Protection Premier and Collective Trip Protection Elite, and at 89 years
on the Collective Total Protection Concierge plan.
